related_documents.title: Gestá a postoje pri svätej omši — smernice k Pastierskemu listu KBS
related_documents.summary: Adopts full VSRM §43 verbatim. Separately retains Slovak custom of kneeling before Ecce Agnus Dei for all Slovakia ('Na Slovensku zachováme'). Kneeling from Sanctus through entire EP only where local parish custom exists ('kde je zvyk'). Pastoral guidance: stand from first sung note of cantor at Alleluia; turn toward ambo during Gospel; sign of peace soberly to nearest neighbours only.
related_documents.adaptations_method: Separate document; NOT embedded in VSRM text

related_documents.title: Usmernenie k uvedeniu tretieho slovenského vydania Rímskeho misála
related_documents.summary: Guidance on introducing the new Slovak Roman Missal. Covers text changes only (new consecration formula, doxology, conclusion of prayers). Does not address posture changes.

notes: The VSRM is published as a standalone document as well as embedded in the Rímsky misál.
Slovak abbreviation: VSRM (Všeobecné smernice Rímskeho misála).
National adaptations for Slovakia are NOT embedded inline in the VSRM text (unlike the US GIRM), but are published as separate KBS pastoral letters and directives.
PDF source appears to be from the standalone VSRM booklet (54 pages, March 2025 print).
